name: Backpropagation with Per-Splat Parallelization
aliases: Recursive Per-Splat Parallelization for Backward Propagation
definition: A parallelization scheme for the 3D Gaussian Splatting backward pass that maps threads to 2D splats instead of pixels to avoid atomic contention on gradient accumulation.
summary: Backpropagation with Per-Splat Parallelization is a GPU kernel optimization for 3D Gaussian Splatting that eliminates atomic contention by parallelizing the backward pass over splats rather than pixels.
